title: Company Node Standard
description: Illustrative organizational Standard: every node must carry an 'ownership' block (costCenter + owner), composed via allOf against the real published core.json node schema — not a new node shape, an addition to it. See ../../README.md 'Standards enforced via Patterns' section for how this is actually exercised against architecture.calm.json.

costCenter.description: Company cost center code, e.g. CC-4471

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this node
